```{r, warning = FALSE, include = FALSE,echo=FALSE}
library(readxl)
#read individual freesurfer-derived phenotypes and calcuate the centiles
datapath='E:/Lifespan_freesurfer_results/Github/Source-codes/'#Change the directory where you save the Source-codes 
datafile ='E:/Lifespan_freesurfer_results/Github/Datasets/Dataset-individual/MR_measures.xlsx' #Change the directory where you save the clinical variables  
clinicalfile<-'E:/Lifespan_freesurfer_results/Github/Datasets/Dataset-individual/Clinical_vars.csv'#Change the directory where you save the MR measures  
feature_path0='E:/Lifespan_freesurfer_results/Github/Models/GAMLSS/DK/' #Chnage the path you have saved your normative models in "Normative-model-fit.R"
model_path='E:/Lifespan_freesurfer_results/Github/Models/DPS' #Change the directory where you save the DPS models
savepath='E:/Lifespan_freesurfer_results/Github/Test_results/case_report';# Create and determine the directory where you would save the results  

clinical_data<-read.csv(clinicalfile);
rownames(clinical_data)<-paste0(clinical_data$Freesufer_Path2,clinical_data$Freesufer_Path3)

path <- list()
str_lab <- 'global_and_local_feature'# change
path[[1]]<-paste0(feature_path0,'aseg.vol.table');
path[[2]]<-paste0(feature_path0,'lh.aparc.thickness.table');
path[[3]]<-paste0(feature_path0,'rh.aparc.thickness.table');
path[[4]]<-paste0(feature_path0,'lh.aparc.area.table');
path[[5]]<-paste0(feature_path0,'rh.aparc.area.table');
path[[6]]<-paste0(feature_path0,'lh.aparc.volume.table');
path[[7]]<-paste0(feature_path0,'rh.aparc.volume.table');
path[[8]]<-paste0(feature_path0,'Global_feature');




RDSfile_all <- NULL
for (i in 1:length(path))
{
  feature_path = path[[i]]

  setwd(feature_path)
  myfile <- list.files()
  RDSfile_all0 <-
    myfile[grep(myfile, pattern = "model.rds$")]
  for (j in RDSfile_all0)
  {
    #RDSfile_all0<-paste0(feature_path,'/',RDSfile_all0);
    RDSfile_all <- c(RDSfile_all, paste0(feature_path, '/', j))


  }
}


setwd(datapath)
#loading for Global_feature
var <-
  c(
    'Global.table',
    'aseg.vol.table',
    'lh.aparc.volume.table',
    'rh.aparc.volume.table',
    'lh.aparc.thickness.table',
    'rh.aparc.thickness.table',
    'lh.aparc.area.table',
    'rh.aparc.area.table'
  )
setwd(datapath)

MRI <- data.frame(read_excel(datafile, sheet = 'Global.table'))
rownames(MRI)<-paste0(MRI$Freesurfer_Path2,MRI$Freesurfer_Path3)

ind<-intersect(rownames(clinical_data),rownames(MRI))

MRI<-cbind(clinical_data[ind,],MRI[ind,])
MRI$Site_ZZZ<-paste0(MRI$City,MRI$Center,MRI$Manufacturer)

individual_name<-c("IndividualIndividual")


all_data1_raw<- MRI[individual_name, c(7,8,9,18)]
all_data1_centile<- MRI[individual_name, c(7,8,9,18)]

 

for (sheet in var)
  #for local feature
{
  setwd(datapath)
  MRI <- data.frame(read_excel(datafile, sheet = sheet))
  MRI<- MRI[!duplicated(paste0(MRI$Freesurfer_Path2,MRI$Freesurfer_Path3)), ]
  rownames(MRI)<-paste0(MRI$Freesurfer_Path2,MRI$Freesurfer_Path3)

  ind<-intersect(rownames(clinical_data),rownames(MRI))

  MRI<-cbind(clinical_data[ind,c(1:18)],MRI[ind,])
  MRI$Site_ZZZ<-paste0(MRI$City,MRI$Center,MRI$Manufacturer)

  MRI <- MRI[c(individual_name, "Case1Case1", "Case2Case2"), ]

  if (sheet == "aseg.vol.table")
  {
    MRI[,'cerebellum_WM']<-MRI$Left.Cerebellum.White.Matter+MRI$Right.Cerebellum.White.Matter
    MRI[,'cerebellum_GM']<-MRI$Left.Cerebellum.Cortex+MRI$Right.Cerebellum.Cortex
    MRI[,'cerebellum_total']<-MRI[,'cerebellum_WM']+MRI[,'cerebellum_GM'];
    MRI[,'CC']<-MRI$CC_Anterior+MRI$CC_Central+MRI$CC_Mid_Anterior+
      MRI$CC_Mid_Posterior+MRI$CC_Posterior
  }

  str = sheet



  if (sheet == "Global.table")
  {
    
     for(col in colnames(MRI)[20:37])
    {
      MRI[,col]<-as.numeric(MRI[,col])
     }
    
    for (i in 1:dim(MRI)[1])
    {
      MRI[i,'mean_thickness']<-
        (MRI[i,'lhMeanThickness']*MRI[i,'lhVertex']+
           MRI[i,'rhMeanThickness']*MRI[i,'rhVertex'])/(MRI[i,'lhVertex']+MRI[i,'rhVertex'])
      
      MRI[i,'total_surface_arrea']<-MRI[i,'lh_totaISA2']+MRI[i,'rh_totaISA2'];
    }
    str = 'Global_feature'

  }

  tem_feature <- colnames(MRI)


  all_data <- MRI

  Z_data_new <- list()

  Quant_data_new <- list()

  
  for (i in tem_feature[1:length(tem_feature)])
  {
    all_data[, 'feature'] <- all_data[, i]

   
    rdsfile<-paste0(i,'_normative_model.rds')
    
    if(i=='Brain.Stem'){rdsfile='BrainStem_normative_model.rds'}
    if(i=='cerebellum_total'){rdsfile='Cerebellum_normative_model.rds'}
    if(i=='mean_thickness'){rdsfile='Cortical_thickness_normative_model.rds'}
    if(i=='total_surface_arrea'){rdsfile='Total_surface_area_normative_model.rds'}

    rads_file<-rdsfile
    

    rads_index <- NULL
    for (rads1 in RDSfile_all)
    {
      if (grepl(rads_file, rads1)) {
        rads_index <- rads1
      }
    }

    if (is.null(rads_index)) {
      next
    }
    
    if (!is.null(rads_index)){
      results <- readRDS(rads_index)
      print(paste0(rads_index, '-vs-', i))
    }



    Z_score_sum <- NULL

    Quant_score_sum <- NULL

    m0 <- results$m0
    m2<- results$m2

    #for mu

    all_data$Sex <- as.factor(all_data$Sex)
    all_data[2, 'Site_ZZZ'] <- 'CC'
    all_data$Site_ZZZ <- as.factor(all_data$Site_ZZZ)


    tem_rnd <- matrix(0, dim(all_data)[1], 1)

    Model.Frame <- model.frame(formula = m2$mu.formula, data = all_data)

    Model.Matrix <- model.matrix(m2$mu.formula, Model.Frame)
    Fit.fix <-
      matrix(m2$mu.coefficients[colnames(Model.Matrix)],
             ncol = 1,
             dimnames = list(colnames(Model.Matrix), 'Beta'))
    if (!is.null(m2$mu.coefSmo[[1]]))
    {
      Fit.fix[length(Fit.fix)] = 0

      for (iz in 1:dim(all_data)[1]) {
        if (all_data$Site_ZZZ[iz] %in% names(m2$mu.coefSmo[[1]]$coef)) {
          tem_rnd[iz] <-
            m2$mu.coefSmo[[1]]$coef[as.character(all_data$Site_ZZZ[iz])]
        } else{
          tem_rnd[iz] <- mean(m2$mu.coefSmo[[1]]$coef)
        }
      }
    } else{
      print('no random effects for this term')
    }


    mu <- exp(as.vector(Model.Matrix %*% Fit.fix) + as.vector(tem_rnd))
    #for sigma
    tem_rnd <- matrix(0, dim(all_data)[1], 1)

    Model.Frame <- model.frame(formula = m2$sigma.formula, data = all_data)

    Model.Matrix <- model.matrix(m2$sigma.formula, Model.Frame)
    Fit.fix <-
      matrix(
        m2$sigma.coefficients[colnames(Model.Matrix)],
        ncol = 1,
        dimnames = list(colnames(Model.Matrix), 'Beta')
      )
    if (!is.null(m2$sigma.coefSmo[[1]]))
    {
      Fit.fix[length(Fit.fix)] = 0

      for (iz in 1:dim(all_data)[1]) {
        if (all_data$Site_ZZZ[iz] %in% names(m2$sigma.coefSmo[[1]]$coef)) {
          tem_rnd[iz] <-
            m2$sigma.coefSmo[[1]]$coef[as.character(all_data$Site_ZZZ[iz])]
        } else{
          tem_rnd[iz] <- mean(m2$sigma.coefSmo[[1]]$coef)
        }
      }
    } else{
      print('no random effects for this term')
    }



    sigma <- exp(as.vector(Model.Matrix %*% Fit.fix) + as.vector(tem_rnd))

    #sigma<-(as.vector(Model.Matrix %*% Fit.fix))
    #for nu

    Model.Frame <- model.frame(formula = m2$nu.formula, data = all_data)

    Model.Matrix <- model.matrix(m2$nu.formula, Model.Frame)
    Fit.fix <-
      matrix(m2$nu.coefficients[colnames(Model.Matrix)],
             ncol = 1,
             dimnames = list(colnames(Model.Matrix), 'Beta'))
    if (!is.null(m2$nu.coefSmo[[1]]))
    {
      Fit.fix[length(Fit.fix)] = 0

    } else{
      print('no random effects for this term')
    }


    nu <- as.vector(Model.Matrix[, colnames(Model.Matrix)[1]] * Fit.fix[1])



    Z_score_sum <-
      zzz_cent(
        obj = m2,
        type = c("z-scores"),
        mu = mu,
        sigma = sigma,
        nu = nu,
        xname = 'Age',
        xvalues = all_data$Age,
        yval = all_data$feature,
        calibration = FALSE,
        lpar = 3
      )

    Quant_score_sum <-
      zzz_cent(
        obj = m2,
        type = c("z-scores"),
        mu = mu,
        sigma = sigma,
        nu = nu,
        xname = 'Age',
        xvalues = all_data$Age,
        yval = all_data$feature,
        calibration = FALSE,
        lpar = 3,
        cdf = TRUE
      )


    Z_score_sum <- data.frame(Z_score_sum)

    colnames(Z_score_sum) <- c('Z_score')


    Quant_score_sum <- data.frame(Quant_score_sum)

    colnames(Quant_score_sum) <- c('Quant_score')


    all_data1_raw<- cbind(all_data1_raw,all_data$feature[1]);
    colnames(all_data1_raw)[dim(all_data1_raw)[2]]<-i
   all_data1_centile<- cbind(all_data1_centile,Quant_score_sum[1,1]);
   colnames(all_data1_centile)[dim(all_data1_centile)[2]]<-i



  }

}

  setwd(savepath)

  write.csv(all_data1_raw,'individual_raw_data.csv')
  write.csv(all_data1_centile,'individual_centile_score.csv')
```

```{r, warning = FALSE, include = FALSE,echo=FALSE}
library("htmltools")
library("webshot") 

export_formattable <- function(f, file, width = "100%", height = NULL, 
                               background = "white", delay = 0.2)
    {
      w <- as.htmlwidget(f, width = width, height = height)
      path <- html_print(w, background = background, viewer = NULL)
      url <- paste0("file:///", gsub("\\\\", "/", normalizePath(path)))
      webshot(url,
              file = file,
              selector = ".formattable_widget",
              delay = delay)
}
```

```{r, warning = FALSE, include = FALSE,echo=FALSE}
if(individual_data$Sex=='Male')
{
individual_data[1,'Sex']<-1
}
if(individual_data$Sex=='Female')
{
individual_data[1,'Sex']<-0
}
individual_data$Sex<-as.numeric(individual_data$Sex)

start_col=6
tem_colnames<-colnames(individual_data)[start_col:dim(individual_data)[2]];
tem_colnames<-gsub('-','.',tem_colnames,fixed = T);
#tem_colnames<-gsub('_','.',tem_colnames,fixed = T);


# tem_colnames[tem_colnames=='total.surface.arrea']<-'total_surface_arrea';

tem_colnames[tem_colnames=='Brain.Stem']<-'Brainstem';

{

  {

    tem_colnames[i_sub]<-paste0(tem_colnames[i_sub],'.volume');
    tem_colnames[i_sub]<-gsub('Right','rh',tem_colnames[i_sub]);
    tem_colnames[i_sub]<-tolower(tem_colnames[i_sub])
  }

  if(str_detect(tem_colnames[i_sub],'Left'))
  {

    tem_colnames[i_sub]<-paste0(tem_colnames[i_sub],'.volume');
    tem_colnames[i_sub]<-gsub('Left','lh',tem_colnames[i_sub]);
    tem_colnames[i_sub]<-tolower(tem_colnames[i_sub])
  }

}

colnames(individual_data)[start_col:dim(individual_data)[2]]<-tem_colnames

individual_data<-data.frame(individual_data)
disease<-c('MCI','AD','PD','CSVD','MS','NMOSD')
#model_path='E:/Lifespan_freesurfer_results/Results/Step3_disease_diagnosis/V7_DK/multivariate_analysis/global_and_local_feature_all_for_ref_group_sample_no_site_match'
library(e1071)
#load the DPS model one-by-one
predict_value_new<-NULL
setwd(model_path);
num=0;
for(i_dis in disease)
{
  model_cross<-readRDS(paste0(model_path,'/',i_dis,'_model_cross_validation.rds'))
  
  for(i_fold in c(1:10))
  {
    num=num+1;
    cur_model<-model_cross[[paste0('svmRadial_',i_dis,'_Model_fold_',i_fold)]]
   
    
    
    prediction<-predict(cur_model,newdata=individual_data,probability = TRUE);

    probabilities <- data.frame(attr(prediction, "probabilities"))
    prediction<-probabilities$X1
    prediction<-data.frame(prediction)
    rownames(prediction)<-rownames(individual_data)
    
    if(num==1){predict_value_new<-prediction}
    if(num>1){predict_value_new<-cbind(predict_value_new,prediction)}
    
    colnames(predict_value_new)[dim(predict_value_new)[2]]<-c(paste0(i_dis,i_fold));
    
  }
  
  predict_value_new[,i_dis]<-rowMeans(predict_value_new[,paste0(i_dis,c(1:10))]);
  

}

saveRDS(predict_value_new,'predictive_values.rds');



Pre_MCI<-predict_value_new$MCI
Pre_AD<-predict_value_new$AD
Pre_PD<-predict_value_new$PD
Pre_CSVD<-predict_value_new$CSVD
Pre_MS<-predict_value_new$MS
Pre_NMOSD<-predict_value_new$NMOSD


library(fmsb)
  
  rad_data0<-data.frame(matrix(NA,3,6));
  rad_data0[1,] <- data.frame(t(c(1,1,1,1,1,1)));
  rad_data0[2,] <- data.frame(t(c(0,0,0,0,0,0)));
  rad_data0[3,] <- data.frame(t(c(Pre_MCI,Pre_AD,Pre_PD,Pre_CSVD,Pre_MS,Pre_NMOSD)));
  colnames(rad_data0)<-c('MCI','AD','PD','CSVD','MS','NMOSD')
  rownames(rad_data0)<-c('Max','Min','value')
  

setwd(savepath);
  png(filename = paste0("disease_risk.png"),
    width = 1500,
    height = 1500,
    units = "px",
    bg = "white",
    res = 300)

  
 p<-radarchart(rad_data0,
             axistype = 1,
             seg=2,
             centerzero=TRUE,
             # Customize the polygon
             pcol = "#2E86C1", 
             pfcol = scales::alpha("#3498DB", 0.5), 
             plwd = 2, plty = 1,
             # Customize the grid
             cglcol = "#AAB7B8", cglty = 1, 
             cglwd = 0.8,
             # Customize the axis
             axislabcol = "#34495E",
             # Variable labels
             vlcex = 1.1, palcex = 1,
             vlabels = colnames(rad_data0),
             caxislabels = c(0,0.5, 
                            0.5*2))
print(p)
dev.off()

write.csv(rad_data0,'Disease_propensity_score.csv')
```
